create_document.description: Create a document from one or more files and send it for signature. The files are fetched from public URLs, so point this at something your workflow has already produced or stored somewhere reachable. Unless draft is true, place at least one field for each recipient; SignWell rejects a request that gives a recipient nothing to sign.
create_document.display_str_template: Create a SignWell document for signature.

document.message: Let me know if anything needs changing before you sign.
document.name: Consulting agreement
document.subject: Please sign the consulting agreement

create_document.name: create_document

parameters.description: The documents to send, each with a name and a publicly reachable file_url.
parameters.name: files

file_url.description: Publicly reachable link to the file. SignWell downloads it itself, so it must not need a login.

name.description: File name to show on the document, e.g. agreement.pdf.

parameters.description: Who needs to sign, as a list of objects. Each needs a name and an email. Set signing_order to a number to control the sequence when apply_signing_order is on.
parameters.name: recipients

email.description: The recipient's email address, where the signature request is sent.

placeholder_name.description: The name of the template role this recipient fills, as set on the template in SignWell, for example 'Client'. Leave blank if the template has a single signer, or when not using a template.

signing_order.description: Where this person falls in the sequence, used when apply_signing_order is on.

parameters.description: Where to place a field (a signature, a text box, a date, ...) on the document, as a list of objects. SignWell rejects a non-draft document unless every recipient has at least one field, so this is required unless draft is true. Each needs a type, an x/y position in pixels, and the page it belongs to; recipient names which recipient (1 for the first entry in recipients, 2 for the second, ...) it is for; file_index names which file (0 for the first) when sending more than one, and defaults to the first.
parameters.name: fields

api_id.description: An id to reference this field's value by later.

file_index.description: Which file this field belongs to, by position in files (0 for the first). Defaults to the first file.

label.description: Label shown above the field. Text and date fields only.

page.description: The page number within the file this field sits on.

recipient.description: Which recipient this field is for, by position in recipients (1 for the first, 2 for the second, ...).

required.description: Whether the recipient must fill this field. Defaults to true.

type.description: The kind of field, e.g. signature, initials, text, date, checkbox.

parameters.description: Name for the document, shown to recipients.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Subject line of the email sent to recipients.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: Message shown in the email sent to recipients.
parameters.name: message

parameters.name: apply_signing_order

parameters.description: Let SignWell send its own automatic reminders to people who have not signed. On by default.
parameters.name: reminders

parameters.description: How many days recipients have to sign before the document expires.
parameters.name: expires_in

parameters.description: Create the document without sending it, so you can review or edit it in SignWell first. Off by default, which sends it straight away.
parameters.name: draft
